title: v2 core, scheduling, locale, conversation and provider evidence proposal
verification_boundary: Synthetic provider fixtures and isolated local databases. Actual carriers, clinic facts, physical devices, acoustic SLOs and supplier price/rights approvals are separate acceptance inputs.

requirements.title: Configuration validation
requirements.acceptance: Invalid origins, missing secrets, provider setup and illegal limits fail with actionable startup errors.
requirements.verified_behavior: Startup validates exact web/native origins, strict flags, numeric bounds, enabled provider credentials, account mappings, approved endpoints, model/voice declarations, processing regions and explicit retirement policies before serving. Error messages identify configuration keys without printing secret values.
remaining_acceptance: Supply actual approved credentials, model rights and processing-region evidence; syntax validation does not certify supplier behavior.
requirements.scope: v2 core integration; does not update the main register or establish live supplier certification

requirements.title: Health and readiness
requirements.acceptance: API reports its own readiness and degraded dependency state accurately without disclosing secrets.
requirements.verified_behavior: A bounded readiness aggregator reports configured dependency scopes only, requiring current approval plus fresh observations for healthy status. Actual speech/calendar/digest probes and provider results record bounded health evidence. SMS send/status, payment request/verify and scoped media room creation, PBX claim, worker lease renewal and verified human join now normalize real handler evidence. Invalid/unknown provider I/O and generic rejections degrade readiness; configuration, simulation, unauthorized events and local policy failures never fabricate an observation.
remaining_acceptance: Validate actual supplier and deployed failure/recovery behavior with approved accounts and routes. Local mock transports do not establish supplier availability.
acceptance_limits: The public /ready reports only aggregates. It does not disclose tenant identifiers or assert clinical readiness.
Media observations are control-plane evidence, not acoustic quality or end-to-end carrier acceptance.

A validated FAILED delivery status can show a reachable status API while the message remains failed. Ambiguous aggregate SMS/payment rejections are degraded because they may include account/configuration errors.
Demo/sandbox simulations and inactive clinic scopes do not create new healthy observations; freshness expires without new evidence.
requirements.scope: v2 core integration; does not update the main register or establish live supplier certification

requirements.title: Graceful shutdown
requirements.acceptance: API/worker/media processes end in-flight work safely, close handles and preserve recoverable jobs.
requirements.verified_behavior: The core runtime caps work by operation count and elapsed deadline, selects oldest/unobserved scopes fairly, preserves dispatched external operations for reconciliation and drains tasks with bounded cancellation. API and media workers share cooperative stop/drain behavior; root supplied real standalone-worker SIGTERM tests.
remaining_acceptance: Execute real RTC/AudioSocket process-signal and forced-stop drills with deployed SDK/carrier handles and subsequent recovery.
Prior real RTC smoke emitted an unknown-FFI-handle cleanup warning; this revision does not claim to have eliminated it or proven a leak.
acceptance_limits: The retained root v2-migration-worker.xml includes two actual POSIX process-signal tests with synthetic in-flight work; bounded task tests are not a full live media shutdown drill.
requirements.scope: v2 core integration; does not update the main register or establish live supplier certification

requirements.title: Provider capability registry
requirements.acceptance: Each integration advertises actual operations, model/endpoint/version, region, data terms and verification state.
requirements.verified_behavior: The tenant capability registry persists actual supported-operation declarations, endpoint/model revision, region, data-terms/evidence references, approver, version and expiry. Production dispatch checks current capability, processor purpose/region and money reservation under the same tenant fence before releasing the transaction for I/O.
remaining_acceptance: Obtain current supplier documentation and owner attestations; a configured flag or operator attestation is not an independent vendor certification.
requirements.scope: v2 core integration; does not update the main register or establish live supplier certification

requirements.title: Roles and memberships
requirements.acceptance: Receptionist, manager, coordinator, billing and technical permissions are explicit and tenant scoped.
requirements.verified_behavior: Manager, coordinator, billing and technical roles have explicit server-side permission sets in addition to the existing roles. Login/me/switch return authoritative permission arrays; current memberships are checked per request. Exact JWT-session revocation survives tenant switching, and all-device logout is a separate explicit action.
remaining_acceptance: Assign actual people to least-privilege clinic roles and review memberships operationally.
requirements.scope: v2 core integration; does not update the main register or establish live supplier certification

requirements.title: Audit of overrides
requirements.acceptance: Privileged access, policy changes, exports, staff interventions and identity corrections record actor and reason.
requirements.verified_behavior: Every authenticated staff API access records actor, tenant, role, route template, method, status and explicit encrypted reason or the documented authorized-route-access basis. Domain overrides retain their separate reason requirements and atomic audit evidence. Raw patient-bearing paths and query strings are not copied into access receipts.
acceptance_limits: Ordinary authorized reads use a generated access basis; this is an explicit policy, not a claim that every read has a separately typed reason. Host/database-administrator actions require deployment audit controls.
requirements.scope: v2 core integration; does not update the main register or establish live supplier certification

requirements.title: Provider and service catalog

requirements.verified_behavior: Per-service versioned rules now carry preparation and insurance notes, first/follow-up/package eligibility and bounded series limits beside existing durations, buffers, prices and resources. Confirmation reads the selected service policy rather than an unrelated clinic-wide FAQ.

requirements.verified_behavior: Structured tenant, practitioner, service and service-rule facts carry source, approver, effective/expiry bounds and a value fingerprint. Production catalog access requires current matching facts; mutation or expiry fails closed. Approved FAQ provenance remains pinned per conversation.

Authenticated receiver routing and exact sender identity continue the same administrative FSM, preserve proof across intent resets and deduplicate signed receipts and encrypted replies.
remaining_acceptance: Deploy and verify the authenticated carrier-to-gateway inbound bridge and real outbound deliveries.
Perform physical-device and representative accessibility/usability testing.

requirements.title: Authoritative calendar selection
requirements.acceptance: Every tenant has one approved appointment authority and connector capability profile.
requirements.verified_behavior: Every tenant has a versioned, expiring approved calendar authority. Internal and external paths are selected in staff APIs and caller tools; the local calendar refuses execution when an external authority is selected. Authority changes require pause and review when active bookings, holds or pending external work exist.
remaining_acceptance: Deploy a supplier adapter implementing the published Hamava calendar v1 contract and attest the actual tenant account identity.

requirements.title: Unknown external write
requirements.acceptance: Timeout after submit creates reconciliation state and does not blindly retry or speak confirmed.
requirements.verified_behavior: External request hashes, scoped idempotency, request/result encryption, leases, attempt history and UNKNOWN/FAILED_REVIEW states survive process boundaries. A lost write response is reconciled by lookup without a second POST. Replays and reconnect displays require current remote readback before confirmed wording.
remaining_acceptance: Run the same timeout/recovery conformance suite against the contracted supplier, including real remote idempotency retention and lookup behavior.
requirements.scope: v2 core integration; does not update the main register or establish live supplier certification

requirements.title: External conflict recovery
requirements.acceptance: A concurrent staff/website write is detected or the action remains supervised pending review.
requirements.verified_behavior: The published adapter contract requires conditional creation/update, idempotency, readback and reconciliation. Writes carry pinned slot/appointment revisions and account identity; source conflicts or uncertain responses remain pending/review, and a changed credential account is rejected before I/O.
remaining_acceptance: Demonstrate atomic conditional writes against the independently operated clinic website/EHR while staff and website writers contend. Local protocol fixtures cannot establish a third-party source actually enforces its advertised preconditions.
requirements.scope: v2 core integration; does not update the main register or establish live supplier certification

requirements.title: State transitions
requirements.acceptance: Held, pending payment/approval, confirmed, cancel/reschedule pending, canceled, expired and failed-review transitions are explicit.
requirements.verified_behavior: Internal appointment states remain transactional. External create/cancel/update have durable pending labels, SENDING/UNKNOWN reconciliation, current verified outcomes and FAILED_REVIEW staff tasks. The voice FSM explicitly waits and resumes on persisted operations without declaring confirmation early.
acceptance_limits: Uncertain external hold release relies on reconciliation plus remote TTL; the application does not claim to roll back a third-party write.
requirements.scope: v2 core integration; does not update the main register or establish live supplier certification

requirements.title: Service rule exceptions
requirements.acceptance: First/follow-up visits, packages and 10/20/40-minute examples honor tenant policy rather than global tiers.
requirements.verified_behavior: First-visit and follow-up eligibility use tenant-scoped attended history and policy windows. Package entitlements reserve/release exact units atomically with booking; replay cannot consume twice, expiry/overdraw rejects, and reschedule rechecks entitlement and policy at its new time.
remaining_acceptance: Approve actual clinic eligibility and package rules.
acceptance_limits: These eligibility and package ledgers are authoritative for internal-calendar bookings. Unsupported external package/deposit policy execution is rejected for staff review, not silently approximated.
requirements.scope: v2 core integration; does not update the main register or establish live supplier certification

requirements.title: Recurrence and bundles
requirements.acceptance: Recurring/session-series and multi-resource bundles have explicit supported limits and per-instance outcomes.
requirements.verified_behavior: The staff session-series API supports at most12 explicitly selected instances, immutable encrypted requests, deterministic child idempotency keys, resumable leases and individual success/failure outcomes. Partial success is retained and replay/resume does not duplicate booked instances; each instance uses normal duration/resource conflict enforcement.
acceptance_limits: There is no unbounded recurrence expansion. The caller supplies explicit instances; package limits can reduce the supported maximum. Cross-supplier recurring series remain a reviewed workflow.
requirements.scope: v2 core integration; does not update the main register or establish live supplier certification

requirements.title: Calendar sync reconciliation
requirements.acceptance: Webhook or polling revisions track lag, stale data and conflicts without creating a shadow source of truth.
requirements.verified_behavior: Signed tenant-bound revision ingestion deduplicates event IDs, rejects conflicting replays, tracks cursor/sequence/lag, invalidates cached confirmations and flags gaps. Bounded polling records progress fairly and requires a complete provider response before clearing a gap; remote data is readback evidence, not a second appointment authority.
remaining_acceptance: Validate the deployed supplier webhook authentication, cursor completeness and actual lag/conflict recovery.
requirements.scope: v2 core integration; does not update the main register or establish live supplier certification

requirements.title: Typed tool gateway
requirements.acceptance: Strict schemas, ownership, authorization, policy, timeout and idempotency checks wrap all model-proposed tools.
requirements.verified_behavior: The active deterministic conversation uses one strict discriminated tool gateway for slots/hold/book/cancel/reschedule. Tool data cannot select a tenant or grant identity proof. Server context owns authorization, policy, phone verification and idempotency; elapsed deadline rejection rolls back local mutation and its receipt.
acceptance_limits: Complete model-tool events can be schema-validated, but no generative model or partial argument-stream executor is deployed. Enabling one requires its own end-to-end adapter conformance gate.
requirements.scope: v2 core integration; does not update the main register or establish live supplier certification

requirements.title: Trusted outcome metadata

requirements.verified_behavior: Committed results expose intent, pinned policy/version tuple, proof state, uncertainty, pending tool and actual FSM outcome separately from speech. External pending/recovered outcomes and booking readbacks remain structured; provider/call/turn traces link durable reservations without transcript text.

Verify language-qualified staff availability and actual pickup.

requirements.title: Latency telemetry
requirements.acceptance: Measure end-of-turn to first audible output and STT/model/tool/TTS/transfer subspans separately.
requirements.verified_behavior: Separate monotonic administrative-tool dispatch spans now persist in the scoped trace with fixed completed/queued/rejected/deadline/failed outcomes and committed/rolled-back transaction labels. Successful spans commit with the turn receipt; replay does not rerun or double-count. Handled failures preserve rollback metadata; unexpected failures retain call-only attempted-span metadata after cleanup. Existing latency reports add successful committed per-tool distributions, while queued/failed/rolled-back attempts remain traceable and excluded from success percentiles. Existing STT/TTS/handoff timing and deterministic-engine/no-model disclosures remain.
remaining_acceptance: Measure end-of-turn to first audible output at physical receivers and establish distributions under the deployed network/device/provider conditions. The local RTC received-PCM smoke is not physical speaker output or an acoustic SLO.
acceptance_limits: No generative model is deployed, so model inference/streaming spans are not fabricated. Adding such a model later requires its own instrumentation and acceptance.
Tool spans cover local dispatch; a queued external operation is not a remote-success observation. Process death/database unavailability can leave unobserved attempts.
requirements.scope: Final authorized MEDIA-012 implementation; does not update main register or establish acoustic acceptance.

BILLING-005 / MEDIA-013.verified_behavior: Paid SIP/WebRTC automated admission reserves maximum authorized automated duration before media access. Missing production rate/budget fails closed. Disconnect, verified human takeover and expiry retain UNKNOWN carrier liability; measured logical elapsed including silence is separate evidence. Repeated finalization is idempotent. Accepted provider work and exact authenticated cost adjustment remain durable if the clinic is deactivated during I/O; new reserve/start attempts are still denied.
limits: Does not reserve carrier spend before application routing or onward human leg. Logical elapsed does not prove supplier final charge. Explicit evidenced reconciliation is required.

PRIVACY-003 / PRIVACY-005.verified_behavior: Public transcript notice and original call retention pin use the strictest tenant/current purpose cap; worker also honors original shorter pin. Processing consent version is retained independently from disabled recording/training. Public non-demo intake requires the exact displayed notice fingerprint, rechecked under the tenant lock; stale or missing notice binding rejects before session creation. Caller consent must be renewed after a notice change. Existing text/media AI turns reject when the current processing purpose is disabled.
limits: Demo-only omitted-fingerprint compatibility is explicitly recorded as displayed_notice_bound=false. Trusted internal channel admission retains its separate consent path and does not claim browser notice binding. Operational notices and lawful retention requirements still need accountable clinic approval.
